c101: No single shared pattern: mixed indoor clutter and warm brown, orange or red objects with hard straight edges, stripes or patches, in mid-scale. Centre is often a warm reddish-orange horizontal patch with a dark band above it; no fur texture or paired round spots.
k163: A rounded dark mass or dark round shape at the centre with a pale vertical stripe running through its middle, flanked by two small dark spots on each side, filling most of the crop; soft fur-like texture, dark and light contrast, blurred background.
k23: Dense, busy, high-contrast repeated texture covering the whole crop: many small similar cells, dots, spots, stripes or thin crossing lines in a regular tiling, strongly saturated or black and white, with no single central shape or empty background.
k275: A dark round disc or circular hole at the centre, ringed by concentric rounded rims, filling about a third of the crop; strong dark core with a small bright glint, surrounded by textured or fur-like, smooth skin-like or metallic surface.
k297: A mid-sized upright shape in the centre-upper area: a rounded warm skin-toned or dark patch on top of a wide, flat, solid-coloured block (shirt or jacket) below it, filling the lower half; background plain or green. Often a side shape beside it.
k305: A dark, small, rounded patch near the centre, set in a lighter, smoother, roughly vertical area that is symmetric left and right, fills about half the crop. Smaller sub-patterns: a tiny dark dot on a pale patch, or a dark spot on skin-toned ground.
k97: A varied mix with no single shape. Most often a dark, murky patch in the lower middle, under a paler warm-toned (skin or tan) area above. Items are close-up and brownish. Smaller parts are glossy curved objects, rounded loops and stripes.
p: Extreme close-up: a soft, fine-textured, warm tan and cream surface filling the whole crop, with a dark rounded blob low-centre or to one side, small dark ovals above it, and sharp light-dark contrast at one edge. Blurry, with little background.
